1. REMOVE SECOND COAST BRAKE PISTON OIL SEAL
RING

AT5260

2. REMOVE SECOND COAST BRAKE PISTON ROD
(a) Firmly hold down the piston, then compress the compression spring.
(b) Using needle nose-pliers, remove the E-ring.
